program.name: Legs Volume
program.subject: Legs & glutes
program.blurb: Three leg days and no upper day: squats, then hinges, then single-leg work.
program.about: Every day is a leg day here. Squats and front squats lead the first, deadlifts, good mornings and bridges the second, and lunges, step-ups and single-leg deadlifts the third. Calves and adductors fill the gaps. Abs finish every session. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
